scope: Predefined source-adjudicated labels for selected admitted reviews in original Kotlin fixtures. Labels are independent of model agreement. Not whole-application recall, deployment exposure, or full language parity. Excluded lookalikes are covered separately by native tests.

cases.source_reason: Accepted selector maps to one fixed server-owned path; other values fail.
File path is fixed and the request parameter is unused.
Request influences content rather than the fixed file target; no CWE-22 path influence.
Resolving and normalizing request name does not enforce root containment.
Request String is converted directly to the unrestricted file read path.
Request String is converted directly to the unrestricted file write path.
Explicitly aliased JVM Runtime executes request-selected command.
Explicit JVM import overrides custom wildcard and executes request-selected command.
Fully qualified JVM Runtime executes request-selected command.
Fixed prepared SQL keeps a request value in a separately bound setString parameter.
Executed SQL is fixed and does not use the request value.
Request String changes SQL before preparation; the prepared statement is subsequently executed.
Explicit request String is interpolated into SQL passed to Statement.executeQuery.
DataSource factory returns canonical Connection; executed SQL is fixed and request input is unused.
DataSource factory returns canonical Connection; fixed placeholder SQL uses separately bound request text.
DriverManager factory returns canonical Connection; interpolated prepared SQL is subsequently executed; injection reproduced with H2.
Canonical inferred Statement executes request-interpolated SQL; benign predicate injection reproduced with H2.
Only the approved selector maps to the exact server-owned loopback approved endpoint. Other selectors throw before access; direct checks confirm rejection and approved success.

Canonical URL openConnection is lazy. This method returns only the connection class name and supplies no connect/read consumer. The loopback request counter confirms no request for this direct control.
The mapped request URL reaches canonical URL construction and resource reading through immutable aliases without a destination policy. Direct loopback execution retrieved the private fixture.

Exact typed coroutineRaw caller context supplies a mapped request URL to fetch. Its coroutine reads the canonical URI/URL resource without a destination policy. Direct loopback execution retrieved the private fixture; no native cross-callable path is claimed.
The supplied request URL is unused. This original control reads the exact server-owned loopback approved endpoint; the target fixture is trusted and does not redirect.
The mapped request URL selects the canonical URL connection; this method connects and reads the response. Direct loopback execution retrieved the private fixture.
The mapped request URL reaches canonical URI/URL resource reading without a destination policy. Direct loopback execution retrieved the caller-selected private fixture.
Caller may enable execution of request-interpolated SQL; true and false branches exercised directly with H2.
Fixed placeholder SQL resets and then binds its own request value before execution.
Request SQL is executed through an immutable alias; an unrelated object binding cannot protect it; H2 predicate injection reproduced.
Fixed SQL is prepared and closed without execution; request input is unused.
Fixed SQL with a separately bound positional value.
Fixed HQL uses a separately bound named value.
The executable is a fixed local literal, with no request-controlled command.
Long binding restricts the interpolated operand to numeric data.
The request chooses the executable and arguments passed to Runtime.exec.
Request name is resolved and normalized without root confinement before Files.readString.
Request name is resolved and normalized without root confinement before Files.writeString.
Explicit request String is interpolated into JdbcTemplate SQL text.
Explicit request String is interpolated into HQL text.
Accepted selector maps to the fixed readme filename; other names are rejected.
Actual OtherPath member ignores input and returns a fixed target.
Explicit member is the canonical EntityManager; same-named local does not change it.
Explicit member is the canonical Path; request selects the read path.
